WITH month_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
store_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT cu.c_last_name, cu.c_first_name, md.d_date
    FROM month_dates md
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = md.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer cu ON cu.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
),
catalog_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT cu.c_last_name, cu.c_first_name, md.d_date
    FROM month_dates md
    JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = md.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer cu ON cu.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
),
web_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT cu.c_last_name, cu.c_first_name, md.d_date
    FROM month_dates md
    JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = md.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer cu ON cu.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_channel
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_channel
    INTERSECT
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_channel
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
